content: Me mapme niŋ Bepaŋdi tubulodaune mik gineŋ fafaŋedok ninadiguk
Wapum adi malabumuŋ minta-gamulune kedem gehitubu-lodaluwaak. Jekop’walaŋ Bepaŋdi kedem gabudokoluwaak.
Adi yoli uŋgoniŋ gineŋ Saiyon uŋoŋ hali kedem gehitubu-kilitiŋa gehitubu-lodawaak.
Eŋ siloŋ timiluwaaŋ hogohogok u kedem yabukahileluwaak, tiŋa dumuŋ hemundumunduŋe timiluwaaŋ u adi nadiune utumba hinek tuluwaak.
Bepaŋdi du maŋgoŋdok nadilaŋ hogohogok u kedem gambaak. Tiŋa maŋgoŋ kwanai hogohogok titiŋdok nadihebet tuguŋ u kedem gehitubu-lodaune tibaaŋ.
Du mik gineŋ fafaŋewaaŋ kaŋ indi wendoktiŋa nadifo tiŋa kap walem toŋa Bepaŋnik wou nintiloneem. Ale Yahwedi yonadige hogohogok kedem nadigambaak.

Kobuk agaŋ nadilat. Yahwe negoŋ me mapme napmeguk, tiŋa nehitubu-lodaune mik gineŋ fafaŋelat. Adi yolikweli momooŋ kunum foloŋ uŋoŋ hali yonadine nadilak. Tiŋa undugoŋ adi ne’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋdi nehitubu-lodaune mik gineŋ fafaŋe tilat.
Me nolidi wosi heki foloŋ be mik diniŋ kalis
heki foloŋ saŋiniŋhik uŋoŋ beiŋ. Iŋgoŋ indi adi Yahwe Bepaŋnik’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ foloŋ hogok wooŋ ulodikilitiyam.
Metam hogohogok adi gweheyeeŋ kadakadapmaneeŋ. Iŋgoŋ indi adi toboniŋ fafaŋe tiŋa pilali yatneem.
Yahwe, du nihitubu-lodaune indi fafaŋe tineem. Wapum, du Mapmenik. Ale nihitubu-lodadok kutiganiyane nadiŋila nihitubu-lodaluwaaŋ.

footnotes.text: “kalis” Mik diniŋ kali wiliŋiŋ lufom hogok, ala meeniŋ uŋgoŋ loyalune wosidi yehimaneune yawagiŋ.
